Before vs. After: Model Calibration & Caution Trap (5,630 Items / 2,815 Pairs)
Comparing neutral zero-nudge closed-book sweeps against prompt-only caution ablation across 34 NASA OSDR studies
Before Guardrails: Raw Neutral Closed-Book (5,630 Items)
Bare OMROSLAB prompt + strict 3-label JSON enum (temperature=0, zero caution coaching)
Trap Overclaim: 99.55% | Ctrl Acc: 48.18% | Ctrl Abst: 0.00% | PDR: 0.00%
Zero abstention yields high raw control guessing (48.18%), but overclaiming on nearly every
multi-study fragility trap completely zeroes Paired Directional Robustness (0.00% PDR).
After Prompt-Only Caution vs. Grounded Tooling
Prompt-only caution shift on gemini-3.5-flash-lite (Full 5,630 Neutral -> 440 Caution Ablation)
All 3 directional claims gemini-3.5-flash-lite still emitted under caution coaching
were false trap overclaims. gpt-5.4-nano ablation: 100.00% abstention, 0.00% PDR.
TARGET PATH (v1.1 / v1.2): GUARDRAIL CONTRACT + GROUNDED OSDR RETRIEVAL
Takeaway: Closed-book PDR sits at the shuffled-pair null; prompt caution erases
valid controls. Pairing EC-01..06 with live OSDR retrieval targets real lift.
